records.cueHe: אמר רבי שמעון בן אבישלום: משל למה הדבר דומה
records.about: why David called it a psalm: like a debtor glad once the note is paid, David rejoiced that the evil from his house was Absalom

records.cueHe: כיון שאמר לו הקדוש ברוך הוא: ״הנני מקים עליך רעה מביתך״
records.about: Nathan's prophecy that evil would arise against David from his own house
'a psalm' because David rejoiced on learning the evil from his house was Absalom, who would pity him
